subject: Marketplace discovery + next steps — ApertureCloud / Redwood
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aperturecloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Saha <priya.s@aperturecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + Marketplace discovery — Redwood <> ApertureCloud

Hey Marcus / Vanessa — thanks again for the intro call earlier. Appreciate the quick overview of Redwood's serving and marketplace model.

Recap from our side: ApertureCloud is evaluating a marketplace integration to surface managed Redwood models for our customers and to offer a managed connector (billing through our marketplace). Key evaluation areas we discussed: entitlement flows, onboarding timeline, data residency for EU customers, and partner billing mechanics.

I've attached a draft mutual action plan (ApertureCloud-MAP_v0.3.pdf) and a short architecture diagram (aperture-architecture.png) that shows our proposed connector placement.

Next step: we'd like a technical deep-dive with your integrations/marketplace owner to walk through API patterns, auth options (token + KMS), and a short integration checklist. Would a 60-min slot next week work? Our availability (PT):
- Tue 11/2: 10:00–12:00
- Wed 11/3: 14:00–16:00
- Thu 11/4: 09:00–11:00

Attendees from our side: Priya (partnerships), Liam (product), + our SRE lead (tbd).

Looking to lock one slot and receive a calendar invite + a short agenda (so our SRE can prepare).

Thanks — Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, ApertureCloud
liam.oconnor@aperturecloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: ApertureCloud-MAP_v0.3.pdf, aperture-architecture.png

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aperturecloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Marketplace discovery — Redwood <> ApertureCloud

Thanks Liam — great conversation earlier. Vanessa, Camila and I reviewed the MAP and architecture diagram. Quick notes attached (precall-notes-marcus.txt).

11/2 at 10:00 PT works for us; we can also do 11/3 at 14:00 PT if you prefer. Proposed 60-min agenda (feel free to tweak):
1) Introductions & success criteria (5m)
2) Integration surface: APIs, auth, billing hooks (20m)
3) Marketplace onboarding flow & entitlements (15m)
4) Security/compliance: data residency, audit logs, and required evidence (10m)
5) Next steps & action owners (10m)

From Redwood: Marcus (partnerships), Vanessa (marketplace program), Camila (integrations/solutions).

If 11/2 10:00 PT is the best, we'll hold that slot and send a calendar invite with the agenda + a short pre-read. Also can include a sandbox service account for your SRE if you confirm the domains.

— Marcus Lin
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments: precall-notes-marcus.txt

From: Priya Saha <priya.s@aperturecloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aperturecloud.com>, SRE Lead <sre.lead@aperturecloud.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Marketplace discovery — Redwood <> ApertureCloud

Hi Marcus / Vanessa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the proposed agenda. 11/2 at 10:00 PT works for Priya and me; our SRE lead will join as well. Please go ahead and send the invite.

A couple of asks so we can come prepared:
- Can you include a short list of API endpoints we should review ahead of time (token exchange, billing webhook, model listing)?
- We need a staging service account for our SRE to test the connector; domain will be @aperturecloud-staging.com.
- Our compliance team will send a short questionnaire about data handling — can we route that to your security contact?

I'll add a tentative calendar hold from our side and share attendee names. Linking the MAP here as well — we'll review the calls-to-action and come with redlines if any.

Thanks,
Priya Saha
Director, Strategic Partnerships | ApertureCloud
priya.s@aperturecloud.com
